ns2:course.label: Ed Prac in Special Fields
ns2:course.description: Course in student teaching to meet requirements for certification in special fields. 2 to 8 undergraduate hours. 2 to 8 graduate hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: For students in the early childhood education curriculum, CI 420 required and concurrent enrollment in CI 421; Satisfactory completion of all requirements of the Council on Teacher Education Undergraduate or Graduate Common Assessment Plan for Initial Certification (http://www.cote.uiuc.edu).
